defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation

  @impl true
  def calculate(cart, _opts, context) do
    coupon_code = Ash.Query.get_argument(context.query, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Ash.Query.get_argument(context.query, :as_of)
    # ash 3 calculation context doesn't expose arguments nicely when loading off-resource.
    # fall back to inputs
    coupon_code = coupon_code || get_in(context, [:input, :coupon_code])
    as_of = as_of || get_in(context, [:input, :as_of]) || DateTime.utc_now()

    items = cart.items || []
    gross = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &line_total/1))
    sub = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &discounted_line_total/1))

    {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, sub)
    dsub = sub - discount
    tax = tax(dsub, cart.region)
    total = dsub + tax

    %{
      gross_subtotal_cents: gross,
      tier_discount_cents: gross - sub,
      subtotal_cents: sub,
      coupon_status: status,
      coupon_discount_cents: discount,
      discounted_subtotal_cents: dsub,
      tax_cents: tax,
      total_cents: total,
      item_count: length(items)
    }
  end

  defp line_total(i), do: i.unit_price_cents * i.quantity
  defp tier_bps(q) do
    cond do
      q < 5 -> 0
      q < 10 -> 500
      q < 25 -> 1000
      true -> 1500
    end
  end
  defp discounted_line_total(i) do
    lt = line_total(i)
    lt - div(lt * tier_bps(i.quantity), 10_000)
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _, _), do: {:none, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(code, as_of, sub) do
    coupon = Ash.read_one!(CartPricing.Sales.Coupon, filter: expr(code == ^code))
    if not coupon do
      {:not_found, 0}
    else
      cond do
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
        coupon.max_redemptions && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions -> {:exhausted, 0}
        sub < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
        true -> {:applied, apply_discount(sub, coupon)}
      end
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:not_found, 0}
  end

  defp apply_discount(sub, coupon) do
    d = div(sub * coupon.percent_off_bps, 10_000)
    if coupon.max_discount_cents, do: min(d, coupon.max_discount_cents), else: d
  end

  defp tax(sub, region) do
    case region do
      :us_ca -> round_half_away_from_zero(sub * 925, 10_000)
      :us_or -> 0
      :eu_de -> round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10_000)
      :jp_13 -> div(sub * 1000, 10_000)
    end
  end

  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n, d) do
    floor(n / d + 0.5)
  end
  defp round_half_to_even(n, d) do
    # rounding half to even: round to nearest, ties to even.
    # round(n/d) ties away at .5, so we need extra logic.
    # simplest: round(n/d) where x.5 rounds to nearest even integer.
    # integer-only:
    x2 = div(n * 2, d)
    if rem(x2, 2) != 0 do
      # fractional part was exactly .5
      # nearest even:
      nearest = round(n / d)
      if rem(nearest, 2) == 0, do: nearest,
      else: (if nearest > 0, do: nearest - 1, else: nearest + 1)
    else
      round(n / d)
    end
  end
end
EOF

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation

  @impl true
  def calculate(cart, _opts, context) do
    coupon_code = get_in(context, [:source_context, :input, :coupon_code])
    as_of = get_in(context, [:source_context, :input, :as_of]) || DateTime.utc_now()

    items = cart.items || []
    gross = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &line_total/1))
    sub = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &discounted_line_total/1))

    {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, sub)
    dsub = sub - discount
    tax = tax(dsub, cart.region)
    total = dsub + tax

    %{
      gross_subtotal_cents: gross,
      tier_discount_cents: gross - sub,
      subtotal_cents: sub,
      coupon_status: status,
      coupon_discount_cents: discount,
      discounted_subtotal_cents: dsub,
      tax_cents: tax,
      total_cents: total,
      item_count: length(items)
    }
  end

  defp line_total(i), do: i.unit_price_cents * i.quantity
  defp tier_bps(q) do
    cond do
      q < 5 -> 0
      q < 10 -> 500
      q < 25 -> 1000
      true -> 1500
    end
  end
  defp discounted_line_total(i) do
    lt = line_total(i)
    lt - div(lt * tier_bps(i.quantity), 10_000)
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _, _), do: {:none, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(code, as_of, sub) do
    coupon = Ash.read_one!(CartPricing.Sales.Coupon, filter: Ash.Query.expr(code == ^code))
    if not coupon do
      {:not_found, 0}
    else
      cond do
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
        coupon.max_redemptions && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions -> {:exhausted, 0}
        sub < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
        true -> {:applied, apply_discount(sub, coupon)}
      end
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:not_found, 0}
  end

  defp apply_discount(sub, coupon) do
    d = div(sub * coupon.percent_off_bps, 10_000)
    if coupon.max_discount_cents, do: min(d, coupon.max_discount_cents), else: d
  end

  defp tax(sub, region) do
    case region do
      :us_ca -> round_half_away_from_zero(sub * 925, 10_000)
      :us_or -> 0
      :eu_de -> round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10_000)
      :jp_13 -> div(sub * 1000, 10_000)
    end
  end

  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n, d) do
    floor(n / d + 0.5)
  end
  defp round_half_to_even(n, d) do
    x2 = div(n * 2, d)
    if rem(x2, 2) != 0 do
      nearest = round(n / d)
      if rem(nearest, 2) == 0, do: nearest,
      else: (if nearest > 0, do: nearest - 1, else: nearest + 1)
    else
      round(n / d)
    end
  end
end

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation

  @impl true
  def calculate(cart, _opts, context) do
    input = Map.get(context, :input) || Map.get(Map.get(context, :source_context, %{}), :input, %{})
    coupon_code = Map.get(input, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Map.get(input, :as_of) || DateTime.utc_now()

    items = cart.items || []
    gross = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &line_total/1))
    sub = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &discounted_line_total/1))

    {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, sub)
    dsub = sub - discount
    tax = tax(dsub, cart.region)
    total = dsub + tax

    %{
      gross_subtotal_cents: gross,
      tier_discount_cents: gross - sub,
      subtotal_cents: sub,
      coupon_status: status,
      coupon_discount_cents: discount,
      discounted_subtotal_cents: dsub,
      tax_cents: tax,
      total_cents: total,
      item_count: length(items)
    }
  end

  defp line_total(i), do: i.unit_price_cents * i.quantity
  defp tier_bps(q) do
    cond do
      q < 5 -> 0
      q < 10 -> 500
      q < 25 -> 1000
      true -> 1500
    end
  end
  defp discounted_line_total(i) do
    lt = line_total(i)
    lt - div(lt * tier_bps(i.quantity), 10_000)
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _, _), do: {:none, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(code, as_of, sub) do
    coupon = Ash.read_one!(CartPricing.Sales.Coupon, filter: Ash.Query.expr(code == ^code))
    if not coupon do
      {:not_found, 0}
    else
      cond do
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
        coupon.max_redemptions && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions -> {:exhausted, 0}
        sub < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
        true -> {:applied, apply_discount(sub, coupon)}
      end
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:not_found, 0}
  end

  defp apply_discount(sub, coupon) do
    d = div(sub * coupon.percent_off_bps, 10_000)
    if coupon.max_discount_cents, do: min(d, coupon.max_discount_cents), else: d
  end

  defp tax(sub, region) do
    case region do
      :us_ca -> round_half_away_from_zero(sub * 925, 10_000)
      :us_or -> 0
      :eu_de -> round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10_000)
      :jp_13 -> div(sub * 1000, 10_000)
    end
  end

  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n, d) do
    floor(n / d + 0.5)
  end
  defp round_half_to_even(n, d) do
    x2 = div(n * 2, d)
    if rem(x2, 2) != 0 do
      nearest = round(n / d)
      if rem(nearest, 2) == 0, do: nearest,
      else: (if nearest > 0, do: nearest - 1, else: nearest + 1)
    else
      round(n / d)
    end
  end
end

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation

  @impl true
  def calculate(records, _opts, context) do
    input = Map.get(context, :input) || Map.get(Map.get(context, :source_context, %{}), :input, %{})
    coupon_code = Map.get(input, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Map.get(input, :as_of) || DateTime.utc_now()

    Enum.map(records, fn cart ->
      items = cart.items || []
      gross = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &line_total/1))
      sub = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &discounted_line_total/1))

      {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, sub)
      dsub = sub - discount
      tax = tax(dsub, cart.region)
      total = dsub + tax

      %{
        gross_subtotal_cents: gross,
        tier_discount_cents: gross - sub,
        subtotal_cents: sub,
        coupon_status: status,
        coupon_discount_cents: discount,
        discounted_subtotal_cents: dsub,
        tax_cents: tax,
        total_cents: total,
        item_count: length(items)
      }
    end)
  end

  defp line_total(i), do: i.unit_price_cents * i.quantity
  defp tier_bps(q) do
    cond do
      q < 5 -> 0
      q < 10 -> 500
      q < 25 -> 1000
      true -> 1500
    end
  end
  defp discounted_line_total(i) do
    lt = line_total(i)
    lt - div(lt * tier_bps(i.quantity), 10_000)
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _, _), do: {:none, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(code, as_of, sub) do
    coupon = Ash.read_one!(CartPricing.Sales.Coupon, filter: expr(code == ^code))
    if not coupon do
      {:not_found, 0}
    else
      cond do
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
        coupon.max_redemptions && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions -> {:exhausted, 0}
        sub < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
        true -> {:applied, apply_discount(sub, coupon)}
      end
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:not_found, 0}
  end

  defp apply_discount(sub, coupon) do
    d = div(sub * coupon.percent_off_bps, 10_000)
    if coupon.max_discount_cents, do: min(d, coupon.max_discount_cents), else: d
  end

  defp tax(sub, region) do
    case region do
      :us_ca -> round_half_away_from_zero(sub * 925, 10_000)
      :us_or -> 0
      :eu_de -> round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10_000)
      :jp_13 -> div(sub * 1000, 10_000)
    end
  end

  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n, d) do
    floor(n / d + 0.5)
  end
  defp round_half_to_even(n, d) do
    x2 = div(n * 2, d)
    if rem(x2, 2) != 0 do
      nearest = round(n / d)
      if rem(nearest, 2) == 0, do: nearest,
      else: (if nearest > 0, do: nearest - 1, else: nearest + 1)
    else
      round(n / d)
    end
  end
end
EOF

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Calculations.CartQuote do
  use Ash.Resource.Calculation

  @impl true
  def calculate(records, _opts, context) do
    input = Map.get(context, :input) || Map.get(Map.get(context, :source_context, %{}), :input, %{})
    coupon_code = Map.get(input, :coupon_code)
    as_of = Map.get(input, :as_of) || DateTime.utc_now()

    Enum.map(records, fn cart ->
      items = cart.items || []
      gross = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &line_total/1))
      sub = Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, &discounted_line_total/1))

      {status, discount} = resolve_coupon(coupon_code, as_of, sub)
      dsub = sub - discount
      tax = tax(dsub, cart.region)
      total = dsub + tax

      %{
        gross_subtotal_cents: gross,
        tier_discount_cents: gross - sub,
        subtotal_cents: sub,
        coupon_status: status,
        coupon_discount_cents: discount,
        discounted_subtotal_cents: dsub,
        tax_cents: tax,
        total_cents: total,
        item_count: length(items)
      }
    end)
  end

  defp line_total(i), do: i.unit_price_cents * i.quantity
  defp tier_bps(q) do
    cond do
      q < 5 -> 0
      q < 10 -> 500
      q < 25 -> 1000
      true -> 1500
    end
  end
  defp discounted_line_total(i) do
    lt = line_total(i)
    lt - div(lt * tier_bps(i.quantity), 10_000)
  end

  defp resolve_coupon(nil, _, _), do: {:none, 0}
  defp resolve_coupon(code, as_of, sub) do
    coupon = Ash.read_one!(CartPricing.Sales.Coupon, filter: Ash.Query.expr(code == ^code))
    if not coupon do
      {:not_found, 0}
    else
      cond do
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.starts_at) == :lt -> {:not_yet_active, 0}
        DateTime.compare(as_of, coupon.ends_at) == :gt -> {:expired, 0}
        coupon.max_redemptions && coupon.redemption_count >= coupon.max_redemptions -> {:exhausted, 0}
        sub < coupon.min_subtotal_cents -> {:below_minimum, 0}
        true -> {:applied, apply_discount(sub, coupon)}
      end
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:not_found, 0}
  end

  defp apply_discount(sub, coupon) do
    d = div(sub * coupon.percent_off_bps, 10_000)
    if coupon.max_discount_cents, do: min(d, coupon.max_discount_cents), else: d
  end

  defp tax(sub, region) do
    case region do
      :us_ca -> round_half_away_from_zero(sub * 925, 10_000)
      :us_or -> 0
      :eu_de -> round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10_000)
      :jp_13 -> div(sub * 1000, 10_000)
    end
  end

  defp round_half_away_from_zero(n, d) do
    floor(n / d + 0.5)
  end
  defp round_half_to_even(n, d) do
    x2 = div(n * 2, d)
    if rem(x2, 2) != 0 do
      nearest = round(n / d)
      if rem(nearest, 2) == 0, do: nearest,
      else: (if nearest > 0, do: nearest - 1, else: nearest + 1)
    else
      round(n / d)
    end
  end
end

ExUnit.start()

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Test do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  alias CartPricing.Sales

  test "CartItem line_total_cents is derived and filterable/sortable" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    item = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "sku1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 3, cart_id: c.id})
    loaded = Ash.load!(item, :line_total_cents)
    assert loaded.line_total_cents == 300
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(line_total_cents > 200)) == [loaded]
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(line_total_cents < 200)) == []
  end

  test "CartItem tier_discount_bps is derived and filterable" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    i1 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id})
    i5 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s5", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id})
    i10 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s10", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 10, cart_id: c.id})
    i25 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s25", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 25, cart_id: c.id})
    assert Ash.load!(i1, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 0
    assert Ash.load!(i5, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 500
    assert Ash.load!(i10, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1000
    assert Ash.load!(i25, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1500
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(tier_discount_bps > 500)) == [i10, i25]
  end

  test "CartItem discounted_line_total_cents is correct and usable alone" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    item = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 6, cart_id: c.id})
    # line_total = 600, tier_bps = 500, discount = floor(600 * 500 / 10000) = 30
    # discounted = 600 - 30 = 570
    assert Ash.load!(item, :discounted_line_total_cents).discounted_line_total_cents == 570
    id = Ash.get!(Sales.CartItem, item.id)
    assert id.discounted_line_total_cents == 570
  end

  test "Cart item_count is filterable" do
    c1 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    c2 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref2", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s3", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c2.id})
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.Cart, expr(item_count == 2)) |> Enum.map(& &1.reference) == ["ref1"]
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.Cart, expr(item_count > 1)) |> Enum.map(& &1.reference) == ["ref1"]
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves for empty cart" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.gross_subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.tier_discount_cents == 0
    assert q.coupon_status == :none
    assert q.coupon_discount_cents == 0
    assert q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.tax_cents == 0
    assert q.total_cents == 0
    assert q.item_count == 0
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves coupon rules in order" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-06-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id}) # sub 100, gross 100, tier 0
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id}) # sub 475, gross 500, tier 25
    # sub = 100 + 475 = 575, gross 600, tier_discount_cents = 600 - 575 = 25

    # no coupon
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :none and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0 and q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575

    # not_found
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "MISSING", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :not_found and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y1", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2027-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y2", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2025-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    # not_yet_active
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y1", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :not_yet_active and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0
    # expired
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y2", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :expired and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y3", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_redemptions: 5, redemption_count: 5)
    # exhausted
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y3", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :exhausted and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y4", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 600)
    # below_minimum (sub 575 < 600)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y4", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :below_minimum and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0 and q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y5", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    # applied, discount floor(575 * 1000 / 10000) = 57
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y5", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :applied and q.coupon_discount_cents == 57
    assert q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575 - 57 == 518

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y6", percent_off_bps: 2000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_discount_cents: 10)
    # applied, discount floor(575 * 2000 / 10000) = 115, capped at 10
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y6", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :applied and q.coupon_discount_cents == 10
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves tax by region and rounding" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-06-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R1", region: :us_ca)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S1", unit_price_cents: 13, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # sub = 13, gross 13, tier_discount_cents = 0
    # us_ca rate 925, tax = floor(13 * 925 / 10000 + 0.5) = floor(1.2025 + 0.5) = floor(1.7025) = 1
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 1 and q.total_cents == 13 + 1 == 14

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R2", region: :us_or)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S2", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 0 and q.total_cents == 10

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R3", region: :eu_de)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S3", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # rate 1900, tax = round_half_to_even(10 * 1900, 10000) = round_half_to_even(19000, 10000) = round_half_to_even(1.9)
    # x2 = div(19000*2, 10000) = div(38000, 10000) = 3. rem != 0. nearest = round(1.9) = 2. even, return nearest=2
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 2 and q.total_cents == 12

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R4", region: :jp_13)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S4", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # rate 1000, tax = div(10 * 1000, 10000) = div(10000, 10000) = 1
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 1 and q.total_cents == 11
  end

  test "pricing_quote with rounding edge cases" do
    # us_ca (925, half away) - tax = floor(sub * 925 / 10000 + 0.5)
    # sub 2, tax = floor(1850/10000 + .5) = floor(.185 + .5) =floor(.685) = 0
    # sub 3, tax = floor(2775/10000 + .5) = floor(.2775+.5) =floor(.7775) = 0
    # sub 5, tax = floor(4625/10000 + .5) = floor(.4625+.5) =floor(.9625) = 0
    # sub 6, tax = floor(5550/10000 + .5) = floor(.555+.5) =floor(1.055) = 1
    for {sub, exp} <- [{2, 0}, {3, 0}, {5, 0}, {6, 1}] do
      c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "#{sub}", region: :us_ca)
      Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "i", unit_price_cents: sub, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
      q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
      assert q.tax_cents == exp, "us_ca sub #{sub} -> tax #{q.tax_cents} != #{exp}"
    end

    # eu_de (1900, half to even) - tax = round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10000)
    # sub 2 -> 3800. x2 = 3800*2/10000=0. even -> round(0.38) = 0
    # sub 3 -> 5700. x2 = 5700*2/10000=1. odd -> nearest=round(.57)=1. even(0). return 0
    # sub 5 -> 9500. x2 = 1. odd -> nearest=round(.95)=1. even(0). return 0
    # sub 6 -> 11400. x2 = 2. even -> round(1.14)=1
    for {sub, exp} <- [{2, 0}, {3, 0}, {5, 0}, {6, 1}] do
      c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "#{sub}", region: :eu_de)
      Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "i", unit_price_cents: sub, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
      q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
      assert q.tax_cents == exp, "eu_de sub #{sub} -> tax #{q.tax_cents} != #{exp}"
    end

    # jp_13 (1000, truncate) - tax = div(sub * 1000, 10000)
    # 2 -> 200/10000=0. 3 -> 0. 5 -> 0. 6 -> 0. 9 -> 0. 10 -> 1.
    # sub 11 -> 11000/10000 = 1
    for {sub, exp} <- [{2, 0}, {3, 0}, {5, 0}, {6, 0}, {10, 1}, {11, 1}] do
      c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "#{sub}", region: :jp_13)
      Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "i", unit_price_cents: sub, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
      q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
      assert q.tax_cents == exp, "jp_13 sub #{sub} -> tax #{q.tax_cents} != #{exp}"
    end
  end

  test "pricing_quote with applied discount exactly at max_discount_cents boundary"
    as_of = ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id) # sub 100, gross 100, tier 0
    # applied, discount floor(100 * 2000 / 10000) = 20. capped at 20
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "C1", percent_off_bps: 2000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_discount_cents: 20)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "C1", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_discount_cents == 20
  end

  test "loading multiple carts in one operation works" do
    c1 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "c1", region: :us_ca})
    c2 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "c2", region: :us_or})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 200, quantity: 1, cart_id: c2.id})
    carts = Ash.load!([c1, c2], [pricing_quote: []], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}})
    assert length(carts) == 2
    q1 = Enum.find(carts, &(&1.reference == "c1")).pricing_quote
    q2 = Enum.find(carts, &(&1.reference == "c2")).pricing_quote
    assert q1.subtotal_cents == 100
    assert q2.subtotal_cents == 200
  end

  test "loading the same cart multiple times with different inputs works" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "c1", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id})
    q1 = Ash.load!(c, [pricing_quote: []], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: nil, as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "SALE", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    q2 = Ash.load!(c, [pricing_quote: []], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "SALE", as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    assert q1.coupon_status == :none and q1.subtotal_cents == 100
    assert q2.coupon_status == :applied and q2.subtotal_cents == 100 and q2.coupon_discount_cents == 10
  end

  test "write constraints are enforced" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, ~r/region/, fn -> Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref2", region: :invalid}) end)
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, ~r/quantity/, fn -> Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 0, cart_id: c.id}) end)
  end

  test "create_coupon! max_redemptions can be nil" do
    coupon = Sales.create_coupon!(code: "SALE", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2026-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    refute coupon.max_redemptions
  end

  test "create functions raise on failure" do
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1"}) end)
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.create_cart!(%{region: :us_ca}) end)
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s"}) end)
  end

  test "get_cart! raises on non-existent id" do
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.get_cart!(Ecto.UUID.generate()) end)
  end
end

ExUnit.start()

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Test do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  import Ash.Query
  alias CartPricing.Sales

  test "CartItem line_total_cents is derived and filterable/sortable" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    item = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "sku1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 3, cart_id: c.id})
    loaded = Ash.load!(item, :line_total_cents)
    assert loaded.line_total_cents == 300
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(line_total_cents > 200)) == [loaded]
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(line_total_cents < 200)) == []
  end

  test "CartItem tier_discount_bps is derived and filterable" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    i1 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id})
    i5 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s5", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id})
    i10 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s10", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 10, cart_id: c.id})
    i25 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s25", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 25, cart_id: c.id})
    assert Ash.load!(i1, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 0
    assert Ash.load!(i5, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 500
    assert Ash.load!(i10, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1000
    assert Ash.load!(i25, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1500
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(tier_discount_bps > 500)) == [i10, i25]
  end

  test "CartItem discounted_line_total_cents is correct and usable alone" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    item = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 6, cart_id: c.id})
    # line_total = 600, tier_bps = 500, discount = floor(600 * 500 / 10000) = 30
    # discounted = 600 - 30 = 570
    assert Ash.load!(item, :discounted_line_total_cents).discounted_line_total_cents == 570
    id = Ash.get!(Sales.CartItem, item.id)
    assert id.discounted_line_total_cents == 570
  end

  test "Cart item_count is filterable" do
    c1 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    c2 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref2", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s3", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c2.id})
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.Cart, expr(item_count == 2)) |> Enum.map(& &1.reference) == ["ref1"]
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.Cart, expr(item_count > 1)) |> Enum.map(& &1.reference) == ["ref1"]
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves for empty cart" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.gross_subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.tier_discount_cents == 0
    assert q.coupon_status == :none
    assert q.coupon_discount_cents == 0
    assert q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.tax_cents == 0
    assert q.total_cents == 0
    assert q.item_count == 0
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves coupon rules in order" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-06-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id}) # sub 100, gross 100, tier 0
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id}) # sub 475, gross 500, tier 25
    # sub = 100 + 475 = 575, gross 600, tier_discount_cents = 600 - 575 = 25

    # no coupon
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :none and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0 and q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575

    # not_found
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "MISSING", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :not_found and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y1", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2027-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y2", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2025-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    # not_yet_active
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y1", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y3", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_redemptions: 5, redemption_count: 5)
    # exhausted
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y3", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :exhausted and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y4", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 600)
    # below_minimum (sub 575 < 600)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y4", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :below_minimum and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0 and q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y5", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    # applied, discount floor(575 * 1000 / 10000) = 57
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y5", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :applied and q.coupon_discount_cents == 57
    assert q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575 - 57 == 518

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y6", percent_off_bps: 2000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_discount_cents: 10)
    # applied, discount floor(575 * 2000 / 10000) = 115, capped at 10
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y6", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :applied and q.coupon_discount_cents == 10
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves tax by region and rounding" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-06-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R1", region: :us_ca)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S1", unit_price_cents: 13, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # sub = 13, gross 13, tier_discount_cents = 0
    # us_ca rate 925, tax = floor(13 * 925 / 10000 + 0.5) = floor(1.2025 + 0.5) = floor(1.7025) = 1
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 1 and q.total_cents == 13 + 1 == 14

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R2", region: :us_or)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S2", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)

  end

    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    i1 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id})
    i5 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s5", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id})
    i10 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s10", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 10, cart_id: c.id})

    assert Ash.load!(i1, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 0
    assert Ash.load!(i5, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 500
    assert Ash.load!(i10, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1000
    assert Ash.load!(i25, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1500

    assert Ash.load!(item, :discounted_line_total_cents).discounted_line_total_cents == 570

ExUnit.start()

defmodule CartPricing.Sales.Test do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  import Ash.Query
  import Ash.Expr
  alias CartPricing.Sales

  test "CartItem line_total_cents is derived and filterable/sortable" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    item = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "sku1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 3, cart_id: c.id})
    loaded = Ash.load!(item, :line_total_cents)
    assert loaded.line_total_cents == 300
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(line_total_cents > 200)) == [loaded]
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(line_total_cents < 200)) == []
  end

  test "CartItem tier_discount_bps is derived and filterable" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    i1 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id})
    i5 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s5", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id})
    i10 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s10", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 10, cart_id: c.id})
    i25 = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s25", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 25, cart_id: c.id})
    assert Ash.load!(i1, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 0
    assert Ash.load!(i5, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 500
    assert Ash.load!(i10, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1000
    assert Ash.load!(i25, :tier_discount_bps).tier_discount_bps == 1500
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.CartItem, expr(tier_discount_bps > 500)) == [i10, i25]
  end

  test "CartItem discounted_line_total_cents is correct and usable alone" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    item = Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 6, cart_id: c.id})
    # line_total = 600, tier_bps = 500, discount = floor(600 * 500 / 10000) = 30
    # discounted = 600 - 30 = 570
    assert Ash.load!(item, :discounted_line_total_cents).discounted_line_total_cents == 570
    id = Ash.get!(Sales.CartItem, item.id)
    assert id.discounted_line_total_cents == 570
  end

  test "Cart item_count is filterable" do
    c1 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    c2 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref2", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s3", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c2.id})
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.Cart, expr(item_count == 2)) |> Enum.map(& &1.reference) == ["ref1"]
    assert Ash.filter!(Sales.Cart, expr(item_count > 1)) |> Enum.map(& &1.reference) == ["ref1"]
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves for empty cart" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.gross_subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.tier_discount_cents == 0
    assert q.coupon_status == :none
    assert q.coupon_discount_cents == 0
    assert q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 0
    assert q.tax_cents == 0
    assert q.total_cents == 0
    assert q.item_count == 0
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves coupon rules in order" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-06-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id}) # sub 100, gross 100, tier 0
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 5, cart_id: c.id}) # sub 475, gross 500, tier 25
    # sub = 100 + 475 = 575, gross 600, tier_discount_cents = 600 - 575 = 25

    # no coupon
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :none and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0 and q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575

    # not_found
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "MISSING", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :not_found and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y1", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2027-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y2", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2025-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    # not_yet_active
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y1", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :not_yet_active and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0
    # expired
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y2", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :expired and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y3", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_redemptions: 5, redemption_count: 5)
    # exhausted
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y3", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :exhausted and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y4", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 600)
    # below_minimum (sub 575 < 600)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y4", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :below_minimum and q.coupon_discount_cents == 0 and q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 575

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y5", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    # applied, discount floor(575 * 1000 / 10000) = 57
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y5", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :applied and q.coupon_discount_cents == 57
    assert q.discounted_subtotal_cents == 518

    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "Y6", percent_off_bps: 2000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_discount_cents: 10)
    # applied, discount floor(575 * 2000 / 10000) = 115, capped at 10
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "Y6", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_status == :applied and q.coupon_discount_cents == 10
  end

  test "pricing_quote resolves tax by region and rounding" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-06-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R1", region: :us_ca)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S1", unit_price_cents: 13, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # sub = 13, gross 13, tier_discount_cents = 0
    # us_ca rate 925, tax = floor(13 * 925 / 10000 + 0.5) = floor(1.2025 + 0.5) = floor(1.7025) = 1
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 1 and q.total_cents == 13 + 1 == 14

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R2", region: :us_or)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S2", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 0 and q.total_cents == 10

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R3", region: :eu_de)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S3", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # rate 1900, tax = round_half_to_even(10 * 1900, 10000) = round_half_to_even(19000, 10000) = round_half_to_even(1.9)
    # x2 = div(19000*2, 10000) = div(38000, 10000) = 3. rem != 0. nearest = round(1.9) = 2. even, return nearest=2
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 2 and q.total_cents == 12

    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "R4", region: :jp_13)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "S4", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
    # rate 1000, tax = div(10 * 1000, 10000) = div(10000, 10000) = 1
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.tax_cents == 1 and q.total_cents == 11
  end

  test "pricing_quote with rounding edge cases" do
    # us_ca (925, half away) - tax = floor(sub * 925 / 10000 + 0.5)
    # sub 2, tax = floor(1850/10000 + .5) = floor(.185 + .5) =floor(.685) = 0
    # sub 3, tax = floor(2775/10000 + .5) = floor(.2775+.5) =floor(.7775) = 0
    # sub 5, tax = floor(4625/10000 + .5) = floor(.4625+.5) =floor(.9625) = 0
    # sub 6, tax = floor(5550/10000 + .5) = floor(.555+.5) =floor(1.055) = 1
    for {sub, exp} <- [{2, 0}, {3, 0}, {5, 0}, {6, 1}] do
      c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "#{sub}", region: :us_ca)
      Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "i", unit_price_cents: sub, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
      q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
      assert q.tax_cents == exp, "us_ca sub #{sub} -> tax #{q.tax_cents} != #{exp}"
    end

    # eu_de (1900, half to even) - tax = round_half_to_even(sub * 1900, 10000)
    # sub 2 -> 3800. x2 = 3800*2/10000=0. even -> round(0.38) = 0
    # sub 3 -> 5700. x2 = 5700*2/10000=1. odd -> nearest=round(.57)=1. even(0). return 0
    # sub 5 -> 9500. x2 = 1. odd -> nearest=round(.95)=1. even(0). return 0
    # sub 6 -> 11400. x2 = 2. even -> round(1.14)=1
    for {sub, exp} <- [{2, 0}, {3, 0}, {5, 0}, {6, 1}] do
      c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "#{sub}", region: :eu_de)
      Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "i", unit_price_cents: sub, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
      q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
      assert q.tax_cents == exp, "eu_de sub #{sub} -> tax #{q.tax_cents} != #{exp}"
    end

    # jp_13 (1000, truncate) - tax = div(sub * 1000, 10000)
    # 2 -> 200/10000=0. 3 -> 0. 5 -> 0. 6 -> 0. 9 -> 0. 10 -> 1.
    # sub 11 -> 11000/10000 = 1
    for {sub, exp} <- [{2, 0}, {3, 0}, {5, 0}, {6, 0}, {10, 1}, {11, 1}] do
      c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "#{sub}", region: :jp_13)
      Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "i", unit_price_cents: sub, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id)
      q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
      assert q.tax_cents == exp, "jp_13 sub #{sub} -> tax #{q.tax_cents} != #{exp}"
    end
  end

  test "pricing_quote with applied discount exactly at max_discount_cents boundary" do
    as_of = ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]
    c = Sales.create_cart!(reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca)
    Sales.create_cart_item!(sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id) # sub 100, gross 100, tier 0
    # applied, discount floor(100 * 2000 / 10000) = 20. capped at 20
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "C1", percent_off_bps: 2000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0, max_discount_cents: 20)
    q = Ash.load!(c, pricing_quote: [], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "C1", as_of: as_of}}).pricing_quote
    assert q.coupon_discount_cents == 20
  end

  test "loading multiple carts in one operation works" do
    c1 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "c1", region: :us_ca})
    c2 = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "c2", region: :us_or})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c1.id})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s2", unit_price_cents: 200, quantity: 1, cart_id: c2.id})
    carts = Ash.load!([c1, c2], [pricing_quote: []], context: %{input: %{as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}})
    assert length(carts) == 2
    q1 = Enum.find(carts, &(&1.reference == "c1")).pricing_quote
    q2 = Enum.find(carts, &(&1.reference == "c2")).pricing_quote
    assert q1.subtotal_cents == 100
    assert q2.subtotal_cents == 200
  end

  test "loading the same cart multiple times with different inputs works" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "c1", region: :us_ca})
    Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s1", unit_price_cents: 100, quantity: 1, cart_id: c.id})
    q1 = Ash.load!(c, [pricing_quote: []], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: nil, as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    Sales.create_coupon!(code: "SALE", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2025-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2027-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    q2 = Ash.load!(c, [pricing_quote: []], context: %{input: %{coupon_code: "SALE", as_of: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]}}).pricing_quote
    assert q1.coupon_status == :none and q1.subtotal_cents == 100
    assert q2.coupon_status == :applied and q2.subtotal_cents == 100 and q2.coupon_discount_cents == 10
  end

  test "write constraints are enforced" do
    c = Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1", region: :us_ca})
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, ~r/region/, fn -> Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref2", region: :invalid}) end)
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, ~r/quantity/, fn -> Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s", unit_price_cents: 10, quantity: 0, cart_id: c.id}) end)
  end

  test "create_coupon! max_redemptions can be nil" do
    coupon = Sales.create_coupon!(code: "SALE", percent_off_bps: 1000, starts_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z], ends_at: ~U[2026-12-31 23:59:59Z], min_subtotal_cents: 0)
    refute coupon.max_redemptions
  end

  test "create functions raise on failure" do
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.create_cart!(%{reference: "ref1"}) end)
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.create_cart!(%{region: :us_ca}) end)
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.create_cart_item!(%{sku: "s"}) end)
  end

  test "get_cart! raises on non-existent id" do
    assert_raise(Ash.Error.Invalid, fn -> Sales.get_cart!(Ecto.UUID.generate()) end)
  end
end
